title: Concentration Curl
summary: A seated one-arm curl with your elbow braced on your inner thigh, for strict biceps work.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for biceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly biceps total.

setup.text: Sit with your elbow against the inside of your thigh, dumbbell hanging.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Lower until your arm is straight.

form_cues.cue: Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder
Keep your upper arm completely still.

mistakes.text: Swinging the torso to lift the weight.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Both sides together.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Biceps long-head stretch, Less peak-contraction focus.
